note: Fail-closed per-gate cardinality contracts for priv/ggen/ash-pplan-durable-chaos-pack.
Keyed by GATE STEM (gates/NNN_stem.rq -> "stem"), not filename.
Every contract is PREDICATE-anchored: the anchor's own blind spot (total loss of the
anchor predicate) is exactly what the companion verify/*.unbound.rq queries name, so
contract + companion have disjoint blind spots.
"invariants" is anchored on dc:order, NOT dc:seed: dc:seed is shared with dc:KillPhase
individuals in this ontology (measured 10 dc:seed subjects = 6 Invariants + 4 KillPhases),
so a seed anchor would over-count. dc:order is carried by Invariants only.
The anchor's blind spot (total loss of dc:order) is named by the companion
